en.topic_title: HK officials bow in apology almost a year after Tai Po blaze killed 168, housing chief steps down
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee and other top officials bowed in apology at a Thursday press conference where Lee announced that housing chief Winnie Ho would step down over the Wang Fuk Court fire, almost a year after the tragedy killed 168 people.
